```{r}
#| label: Row of links
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
content = rowwise_table(~name, ~icon, ~link,
                        "About", "info-circle-fill", "about/index.html",
  "Committees", "person-rolodex", "about/committees.html",
    "Membership", "people-fill", "membership/index.html", 
    "Funding", "award-fill", "awards/index.html",
    "Students", "mortarboard-fill", "resources/students/index.html"
  
)
div(
  class = "bg-breakout",
    div(class = "inner-container",
      div(class = "boxed-wrapper",
            div(class = "boxed-feature-grid",
          pmap(content, function(name, icon, link) {
            div(class = "boxed-feature-grid__item",
              div(class = "boxed-feature-grid__icon",
                a(href = link, class = "boxed-feature-grid__link",
                  "aria-label" = name,
                  tags$i(class = sprintf("bi-%s boxed-feature-grid__i", icon))
                )),
    div(class = "boxed-feature-grid__title", name)
)
          })
        )
      )
    )
  )

```

# Welcome from Our President
::: vspace
:::

::: president-intro
<p>Welcome to the American Psychology-Law Society (AP-LS), Division 41 of the American Psychological Association.</p>

<p>Our organizational mission is to "enhance well-being, justice, and human rights through the science and practice of psychology in legal contexts." AP-LS is the premier organization for students and professionals who are interested in issues at the intersection of psychology and law.</p>

<p>As an organization, we strive to support our members in their work using psychological science and practice to advance justice in our legal system.</p>
:::

::: about-link
[MORE FROM THE PRESIDENT](about/presidents/index.html)
:::
:::

```{r}
                        "general", "Publications", "journals", "publications/index.html", "Learn about journals, book series, etc. from APA Division 41",
   "general", "Newsletter", "newspaper",  "newsletter/index.html", "Read the latest news from our membership",
    "general", "Job Posts", "briefcase-fill", "resources/job-postings/index.html", "Browse recent job listings",
      "general", "Community", "person-fill-exclamation", "about/standards.html", "NEW! Learn about the AP-LS Community Standards",

    "general", "Videos", "play-circle", "resources/videos/index.html", "Collection of webinars, talks and videos",
      "general", "Past Conferences", "chat-dots", "conferences/archive/index.html", "Browse programs from past AP-LS Conferences"

)
setkeyv(content, "category")
```



```{r, echo = FALSE}
# This grid directly follows the h1 president welcome, so its card titles
```
